  {"step": 3, "file": "src/io/gml.c", "function": "igraph_read_graph_gml", "line": 310, "var": "atrec->type", "code": "if (type1 == IGRAPH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMERIC && type2 == IGRAPH_I_GML_TREE_STRING) { atrec->type = IGRAPH_ATTRIBUTE_STRING; }", "note": "In the second edge, 'foo' appears as a TREE (list) type. The type update only handles STRING, not TREE, so atrec->type remains IGRAPH_ATTRIBUTE_NUMERIC."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/io/gml.c", "function": "igraph_read_graph_gml", "line": 441, "var": "atrec->value", "code": "igraph_vector_t *v = (igraph_vector_t *)atrec->value;", "note": "Second pass over edges: atrec->value points to an allocated igraph_vector_t for the numeric attribute 'foo'."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/io/gml.c", "function": "igraph_i_gml_toreal", "line": 71, "var": "type", "code": "int type = igraph_gml_tree_type(node, pos);", "note": "igraph_i_gml_toreal is called with the TREE-typed 'foo' attribute from the second edge. The type is IGRAPH_I_GML_TREE_TREE, which is not INTEGER or REAL."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/io/gml.c", "function": "igraph_i_gml_toreal", "line": 79, "var": "IGRAPH_ERROR", "code": "IGRAPH_ERROR(\"Internal error while parsing GML file\", IGRAPH_FAILURE);", "note": "The default case triggers IGRAPH_ERROR, which calls igraph_error() and unwinds the FINALLY stack, destroying the trie, attribute records, and other resources."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/io/gml.c", "function": "igraph_i_gml_destroy_attrs", "line": 42, "var": "atrec->value", "code": "igraph_vector_destroy(value); igraph_Free(value);", "note": "The FINALLY cleanup frees the igraph_vector_t pointed to by atrec->value and destroys the trie via igraph_trie_destroy, setting its data pointer to NULL."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/io/gml.c", "function": "igraph_read_graph_gml", "line": 431, "var": "trie", "code": "IGRAPH_CHECK(igraph_trie_get(&trie, name, &from));", "note": "After igraph_i_gml_toreal returns the error code (treated as a double since it returns double), the caller continues execution. At line 431, igraph_trie_get is called on the destroyed trie, accessing freed memory - use-after-free."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/core/trie.c", "function": "igraph_trie_get_node", "line": 141, "var": "t->strs", "code": "igraph_strvector_size(&t->strs)", "note": "igraph_trie_get_node calls igraph_strvector_size on the destroyed trie's strvector. The assertion sv->data != 0 fails because the data was freed, causing a crash."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace updated"
